name: fullstack-oidc
description: Reference full-stack app that acts as an OIDC relying party fronted by Moses (BFF pattern) using the vendored oidcauth middleware. React frontend + Go backend + PostgreSQL.

external.description: App-issued JWT signing key (NOT the OIDC client secret — that is platform-managed). This key validates tokens minted on either track, so sharedAcrossTracks=true is the right shape — dev and stable both verify against the same key. (For an internal-only encryption key, leave sharedAcrossTracks=false so each track gets its own value.)

App-data encryption key — platform-generated, no admin action needed. Dev and stable each get their own independent value (security-first default). Flip sharedAcrossTracks to true ONLY for an app-issued token that must validate across a dev→stable promotion.

commands.name: frontend-lint
commands.run: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev --ignore-scripts && npm run lint

renovate.context: OIDC relying-party app with React frontend, Go backend, and PostgreSQL. Update npm packages, Go modules, Docker images, and Helm chart dependencies.

logMonitor.context: Full-stack OIDC relying party. Common errors: OIDC discovery/JWKS fetch failures, token-exchange errors, session cookie issues, and PostgreSQL connection failures.
